== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Dagobah: Yoda's Hut (V)]] (original printing), Virtual Set 16, as the PC published it on 3 September 2021, taken unchanged from the PC's card-image repository ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/dagobahyodashut.gif holotable commit b4a011a], file <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/dagobahyodashut.gif</code>; a PNG file served under a .gif name). Not a recreation.
